summary: Arc holds: L1 sequence (Bers/NRC) -> L2 loops (Sorva) -> L3 predict (Battista) -> L4 alter -> L5 capstone. Each consolidation previews next day. Coda 'STEP by STEP' and Looper 'Pick the BIG number / Loops make it SHORT' thread across lessons. C3.1 -> L1/L2/L5; C3.2 -> L3/L4/L5; expectation text byte-identical. Vocab introduced as skill is taught. Materials everyday; puppets optional. Capstone references Days 1-4 in minds_on and gallery walk, but action runs as one individual project rather than four stations named per-day -- capstone_integration sits at 3, the single allowed arc-level slip.
